decision: OCCT 8.0.1 is the project kernel pin. It supersedes the 7.8.1 that FreeCAD bundles: the official release ships headers, import libraries, DLLs and CMake config, the baseline is C++17, and 8.0.1 contains the modelling/meshing/healing fixes the gate needs. The cost is API churn: QymCAD's 7.x reference bridge does not compile against it, so the OM9 bridge is authored for the 8.0 API.

source_archive.used_for: the accuracy patch build (TKG3d) and the license notices

windows_release.contents: 7478 headers (inc/), 74 import libraries and 74 DLLs (win64/vc14/{lib,bin}), CMake config
windows_release.used_for: the gate probe and day-to-day linking

windows_3rdparty.reason: the 8.0.1 DNUs link TBB and jemalloc; without them the process exits with STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND

accuracy_patch.scope: TKG3d only; both the R7-branch and the normal branch are corrected; every other toolkit keeps the release binary
accuracy_patch.defect: The 3D offset helper normalises the offset normal by R = |p' x V| and then expands the quotient rule by hand. In 8.0.1 the D2 line applies the Ndir correction with Subtract while its own comment states Add, and the D3 expansion carries a spurious 6*Dr^2/R^4 term, uses 6 instead of 9 on the Dr*D2r/R^4 term, and scales D3r without the 1/R^2 factor. The correct expressions (derived by differentiating in R' = Dr/R, R'' = (D2r - Dr^2/R^2)/R, R''' = (D3r - 3R'R'')/R) are Ndir*(3Dr^2/R^4 - D2r/R^2) for D2 and DNdir*(9Dr^2/R^4 - 3D2r/R^2) + Ndir*(9Dr*D2r/R^4 - 15Dr^3/R^6 - D3r/R^2) for D3.
accuracy_patch.status: patch verified and rebuilt on this machine: build-receipt.json records configure/build exit 0, 108 SDK headers byte-equal to the source archive, and every untouched shared output hash unchanged; the rebuilt TKG3d.dll is 1236992 bytes sha256 40cd47e72bf1c1980a0a5dfa1cc53962885ffbdc579ac40dbef64589a98f5632
accuracy_patch.prior_acceptance: docs/validation/2026-10-12-rhino-core-acceptance-offset-d3.md (45 D3 queries against the independent 70-digit definition, GREEN 12/12) and tests/native/occt_offset_d3_probe.cpp
accuracy_patch.upstream_status: Checked 2026-10-17 against OCCT master: the D2 expression is already corrected there (Ndir.Multiplied(3Dr^2/R^4 - D2r/R^2) with Add), so the patch only backports that fix to 8.0.1; the D3 expression is still the old one in master, so the D3 part of the patch fixes a bug that is unfixed upstream at that commit.

removal_gate.rule: run it against every new OCCT SDK; PATCH_REQUIRED keeps the patched TKG3d, PATCH_NOT_NEEDED drops it and the pin is updated
removal_gate.measured_8_0_1: stock fails ellipse D2 4.166e-01 / D3 9.996e-01 and spline D2 7.180e-01 / D3 1.001e+00; patched passes at 4.5e-09 / 3.4e-08 / 9.6e-09 / 1.6e-05

accuracy_patch.performance: The patch changes coefficients only (one term removed, one 1/R^2 factor added); no measurable performance cost. The real cost is maintenance and the LGPL obligation to publish the modified TKG3d source (patch + build script), which is why the removal gate exists.

sdk_layout.note: tools/build_occt_offset_d3.py reads this layout, so implementation/tools/fetch_occt.py materialises exactly this structure from the release archive

toolchain.generator: Visual Studio 17 2022 for probes; Ninja for the patched TKG3d rebuild

vendor_reported_8_0_1: BRepCheck_Face ClassifyWires ~8x on a 2000-hole face (9.21 s -> 1.11 s)
curve-on-surface fast path: boolean ~17-20% faster with unchanged geometry
fillet reconstruction state is thread_local, making parallel reconstruction safe
performance.om9_measured: The conformance probe measures accuracy only (stock offset D2/D3 error 41% / ~100%; patched <= 1.6e-05 relative). Throughput 7.x vs 8.0.1 is still unmeasured: no official 7.x Windows package exists on GitHub (V7.8.1 / V7.9.3 release lookups return 404).

limitations: The OM9 Rust bridge (crates/om9-kernel) does not exist yet; M00-L4-02-01-04 and L3-02/L3-03 remain open.
8.0.x is new (8.0.0 May 2026, 8.0.1 July 2026): fewer field-tested patches than the 7.8/7.9 line, and most third-party samples still target 7.x.
The performance numbers above are Open Cascade's, not ours.

build_environment.msvc_env: vcvars64.bat required; Ninja needs cl.exe, INCLUDE and LIB on the child environment
build_environment.path_pitfall: cmd expands %PATH% at parse time, so `call vcvars && set PATH=...;%PATH%` drops the MSVC directories; set PATH in the parent process instead
build_environment.rtk_wrapper: tools/build_occt_offset_d3.py no longer wraps cmake/git in the rtk proxy by default: the proxy does not carry the MSVC environment (--rtk opts back in)
build_environment.ninja: ninja 1.13.2 (pip --user) used for the patched TKG3d rebuild
